tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the PC screen and save it as a PNG file inside the workspace.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to save the PNG. Defaults to screenshots/screen.png.

region.description: Optional capture region as [x, y, width, height]. Captures the full screen if omitted.

tools.name: describe_screen
tools.description: Capture the PC screen and use a vision model to describe what is shown. Returns a text description.

prompt.description: What to ask the vision model about the screen. Defaults to a general description.

save_path.description: Optional workspace-relative path to also save the captured PNG.

region.description: Optional capture region as [x, y, width, height]. Captures the full screen if omitted.
